info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Credit Management API
info.description: The Credit Management API enables clients to assess and manage credit-related information efficiently. Through this API, users can retrieve comprehensive credit data, including credit limits, outstanding balances, and transaction history. This functionality is essential for financial institutions and businesses looking to streamline their loan processing and credit assessment workflows. Typical consumers of this API include banking professionals, financial analysts, and software developers building financial applications.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve details of a specific credit management resource identified by RES-100045. Utilizing this API, developers can access essential information necessary for managing credit effectively.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve information related to credit management operations for the specified resource. Ensure that the request payload complies with the defined schema for a successful operation.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the requested credit management resource.
